slides.label: Verse 1
lines: Through it all, You have never
wavered in Your love
With You there are no maybes
Only certainty in You

slides.label: Verse 2
lines: Lord, our righteousness
You who had no sin became for all
To make sure there are no wrinkles
You chose to live in us

slides.label: Verse 3
lines: You’re the God whose stories we’ve heard
All great indeed
You’re the primal force in all worlds
You birthed all things
The true vine, we’re magnified with Your life

slides.label: Verse 4
lines: The one and only God, You are
The Faithful One, You are
The constant being, You are divinity

slides.label: Verse 7
lines: Even with a gentle voice
Lord, Your voice is stronger
than the world
Some try to erase Your existence
But creation breathes Your name

slides.label: Verse 8
lines: We are not alone
Your Spirit in us, our comforter
We bask in goodness and mercy
Everyday of our lives
